note: Agent configurations, not skills. Instantiate only what a task needs. Implementer and verifier are never the same agent instance.

architect.purpose: Choose the shape before code: boundaries, interfaces, one decision with its cost.
architect.verification: artifact names two options, one decision, reversal cost, and an executable check
stop_when: two options fail a hard constraint
forces cannot be sourced
the change turns out to be one file

planner.purpose: Cut work into ordered, independently verifiable units and name the parallel set.
planner.verification: every unit has a check and a rollback; dependencies acyclic; parallel groups disjoint
stop_when: requirement has no check
two units cannot be separated
plan exceeds approved limits

implementer.purpose: Make the smallest change that satisfies one unit, with its test.
inputs: handoff brief: goal, files, check, no-touch list
artifacts: test that fails before and passes after

forbidden: CI config unless the unit owns it

implementer.verification: unit check passes; suite green; no file outside the brief
stop_when: the check cannot be made to fail
the fix needs a file outside the brief
behaviour change beyond the unit

designer.purpose: Define the product surface as implementation-ready requirements.
artifacts: requirements doc: states with copy, accessibility checks, responsive rules, acceptance list

forbidden: styles/** unless the unit owns it

designer.verification: every state named with copy; accessibility as checks; disclosure of what was not rendered
stop_when: no brief constraint can be named
the requirement is an API or data question
visual quality is claimed without a renderer

investigator.purpose: Answer one question about behaviour, read-only.
inputs: one question in the form the answer will take
artifacts: explanation with evidence and the unknowns
investigator.verification: every claim cites a file, a command or a measurement; inference is labelled
stop_when: the question cannot be answered with the available evidence
the work turns into a change

reviewer.purpose: Read a diff for defects, independently of the author.
inputs: the requirement it claims to satisfy
artifacts: findings with file and line, blocking vs optional
reviewer.verification: each finding names the defect and the evidence; no finding without a location
stop_when: the diff cannot be read in one pass (request a split)
the reviewer wrote part of the diff

verifier.purpose: Produce evidence from the real surface, independently of the author.
artifacts: evidence: commands, exit codes, output, captured states
verifier.verification: each claim attaches to a real observation; missing tools reported, never simulated
stop_when: required tool unavailable
the software will not start
the surface is destructive or production

integrator.purpose: Combine independent changes and prove the combined state.
inputs: each change with its own proof
integrator.verification: combined check spans both changes; both branches preserved; recovery written down
stop_when: combined check fails
a branch is unverified alone
contradictory intentions need a product decision
